conditions.name: water
conditions.note: stone is damp from seep/condensation — NOT pooled. Not enough to douse anything. No standing water on this floor.

description: The cold, near-lightless room Alan woke in. Old ash and grit underfoot, faintly damp stone, the great vertical dark of the shaft above. One iron door, ajar, to the chamber.

exits: none — only the iron door to the chamber

things.name: rusted iron bar
things.note: the one genuinely useful find here — the search prize

things.name: charcoaled timber / fallen beam
things.use: none — crumbles to charcoal at a touch

things.name: brittle bowl fragment
things.note: hints the landing was once inhabited

things.name: drifted grey ash + grit
things.use: throwable handful (eye/distraction, low intent unless aimed cleverly)
